text: Example Foods announced the closure of a demonstration bakery facility in Example City as part of a portfolio review.
Sample Beverage Co. is shutting down a pilot production line at its Sampletown plant, affecting approximately 120 roles.
Illustrative Snacks Ltd. is expanding an existing Midwest manufacturing site with two new packaging lines and a cold-storage upgrade.
Placeholder Dairy invested in additional fermentation capacity at a legacy facility to support growing demand for yogurt products.
Demo Plant-Based Inc. is constructing a new oat processing facility in Sample County with an expected annual capacity of 30 million litres.
Synthetic Ingredients Group broke ground on a greenfield flavour manufacturing site serving European customers.
Example Wellness Brands launched a high-protein yogurt range developed for a major sporting event marketing campaign.
Sample Cereals introduced a plant-based breakfast line positioned as a sustainable alternative to traditional cornflakes.
Illustrative Pack Co. moved several SKUs to recyclable paper-based packaging as part of a 2024 sustainability roadmap.
Placeholder Drinks reduced plastic use in multipack wraps by switching to a certified recycled film across its sparkling water range.
